parameters.query:
INSERT INTO docs (tenant_id, source_url, title, content, chunk_index)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5::int)
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, source_url, chunk_index)
DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  content = EXCLUDED.content
RETURNING id AS doc_id, tenant_id, source_url, title, content, chunk_index;

INSERT INTO doc_embeddings (tenant_id, doc_id, chunk_index, embedding)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::int, $4::vector)
ON CONFLICT (doc_id, chunk_index)
DO UPDATE SET
  embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding
RETURNING $1::uuid AS tenant_id, $2::uuid AS doc_id, $3::int AS chunk_index, $5 AS source_url, $6 AS title;
